pre_remediation_findings.quote_storage: Flat pricing fields on work_orders (quoted_price, price_status, quote_notes). No quote_negotiation_history array.
pre_remediation_findings.reject_semantics: reject_quote_for_work_order set price_status=REJECTED, preserved contractor_id and work order, cleared approval only.
pre_remediation_findings.after_rejection: Contractor could resubmit (REJECTED -> QUOTED). Work order and assignment persisted. No automatic cancel/reassign.
pre_remediation_findings.workflow_termination_risk: LOW for assignment — HIGH for UX semantics: landlord 'Reject quote' read as job/contractor rejection; no revision reason codes; no contractor email on rejection.
pre_remediation_findings.quote_lineage: None — resubmit overwrote quoted_price in place; prior amounts not retained in structured history.
pre_remediation_findings.landlord_rejection_reason: Optional free-text quote_rejection_reason only; no reason_code enum.
pre_remediation_findings.contractor_notification: None on quote rejection/revision request (client notified on submit only).
pre_remediation_findings.rejected_quotes_visible: Last quoted_price remained until resubmit; no version history UI.
pre_remediation_findings.admin_audit: AuditAction.WORK_ORDER_QUOTE_REJECTED_BY_CLIENT with pricing_event quote_rejected; no lineage view.

gaps_requiring_remediation: QUOTE_NEGOTIATION_GAP: binary reject label vs revision-request intent
WORKFLOW_TERMINATION_RISK: contractor UX implies decline not negotiation
Missing governed revision API with reason codes
Contractor portal lacked revision feedback panel
